name: Cemantic Infra-Tech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2000, Quantum Build-Tech Ltd is primarily engaged in construction of residential complexes
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company used to deal in computer software and allied activities and developed few financial applications and exported these to USA and Europe. After company was acquired by new promoters, it also started dealing in construction projects.

cons: Stock is trading at 4.67 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -10.6% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
